system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"God (Yahweh) as a radiant divine presence, depicted through pure light rather than a visible human form","action":"Speaking forth light; the first radiance breaks through the total darkness over the deep","setting":"Formless primeval void over dark waters, with no earth yet formed, the surface of the deep stretching into darkness","secondaryElements":"Faint luminous ripples on the dark waters where the Spirit hovers; no human figures present","mood":"Sacred dread and solemn wonder, the sudden birth of order from chaos","timeOfDay":"Primeval cosmic time, the first moment of light after total darkness on day one","composition":"Wide open void with a single bright radiant source high above, light spilling downward across the dark water surface"}
